records.text: People whom Candace Owens described as being in Melania Trump's circle believed Laura Loomer was the person most likely to harm Donald Trump.

appearances.snippet: In fact, I am told by people in Melania's circle that they believe like actually the most likely person to harm Donald Trump would be Laura Loomer.
